arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push from pod power vs fitted current; persistently negative = extra drag (weed, rudder) or pod/GPS fault

arguments.message: pod reserve low with far to go
boat and pod reserve disagree: drag, current or instrument problem
boat slower than pod power plus fitted current: possible weed on rudder or drag

arguments.text: PLAN (1 min): 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back; leg 1 north has push +0.22 so even legs will be against it. Start hard (shaft 206 W vs CP 154, pod reserve 81%). Expect paddler to settle; if still well above sustainable at 3 min, cue ease. Avoid ground-pace targets (current flips each leg); if pacing, slightly more effort on against-current legs. Watches set: pod_reserve_low, reserves_disagree, drag (drag_gap = push_local - push_along < -0.15), fade (fade_pct not streaming, may never fire). Check CP: test may be 10-25% off.

text: no cue: start is hard as expected; set watches for reserve, drag and instrument disagreement and wrote a pacing plan

arguments.text: Settle now, long race. Ease to your steady rhythm.

4.0 min, 800 m: still above sustainable (shaft 176 vs sust 158, pod reserve 48%, boat reserve 29%, both falling ~7-10%/min). Cued ease (no pace target). Paddler says 4/10, plenty: either CP test underestimates them or they misjudge. Check next wake-up: did shaft drop toward ~158? If they stay above CP without fading speed at same rate, consider raising CP (max 3 changes). Turn at 1000 m; leg 2 against current (~-0.25).

text: cued ease: still well above sustainable power at 4 min with pod reserve under half; paddler reports 4/10, noted to check CP

arguments.message: boat and pod reserve now disagree by over 40 pts

arguments.text: 4.8 min: reserves_disagree fired (boat 21% vs pod 42%). Not drag: boat/shaft power ratio 0.62-0.65 vs test 0.60 and push_local matches push_along, so boat model is just more pessimistic (W/CP 82 s vs pod 104 s). Trust the pod reserve. Replaced watch with 0.4 threshold. Ease cue at 4.1 barely followed (shaft 176 -> 172). At 172 W shaft pod empties in ~1.1 km. Will re-cue ease after the turn if pod reserve keeps falling and shaft stays > 165.

text: no cue: disagreement is model calibration not drag; cue gate closed for 16 s and turn imminent, will reassess after the turn

arguments.text: Too hot for eight k. Ease a touch, long smooth strokes.

6.0 min, 1150 m (leg 2, against current -0.24): shaft held 172-175 for 3.5 min, pod reserve 33% (empties ~800 m), boat 9%. Speed water drifting 3.05 -> 2.99 at same rate (~-2%), boat/shaft ratio 0.645 -> 0.61. Paddler 5/10 plenty (was 4). First ease ignored. Cued ease again with ground pace 185 (~161 W shaft on this adverse leg). MUST re-cue after turn at 2000 m: a 185 ground target is far too slow with current (with-current ground pace ~ 160-165). If shaft stays ~175 with no fade for 10 min, cp_implied may appear -> consider raising CP.

arguments.message: past turn at 2000 m: with-current leg 3, re-cue pace if a 185 target is still being chased

text: cued ease to 185 ground pace on the against-current leg: pod reserve 33% and falling with 6.8 km left, first ease ignored; watch set to re-check after the 2000 m turn

arguments.text: Not yet. Ease to steady, save that for the last k.

8.9 min, 1620 m: paddler said Feeling great, I am going (wants to push). But speed at same rate fading -1 -> -2.7 -> -3.7 -> -4.3%, shaft 175 -> 165, boat reserve 0, pod 18%. Looks like real fatigue: CP test roughly right, paddler overconfident. Cued ease (no pace). Plan: get shaft to ~150-155 for a few min so pod reserve recovers; hold there; finish push from ~1000 m left only if pod reserve allows. Do not raise CP.

text: cued ease: paddler wants to push but speed at same rate is fading 4% and pod reserve is 18% with 6.4 km left

arguments.name: boat_eff
arguments.description: share of shaft power reaching the boat; race so far 0.59-0.65

arguments.message: boat getting much less power than the pod gives: drag (weed on rudder?), blade, or instrument

arguments.text: 9.6 min: ease taking hold (shaft 159). Fade alert -4.6% is mostly the lower power (shaft -9% gives ~-3% speed), not drag. Removed fade watch (confounded by easing); added boat_eff = power_w/shaft_power_w watch < 0.54 (race so far 0.59-0.65).

arguments.name: boat_eff
arguments.description: share of shaft power reaching the boat; race so far 0.59-0.65

text: no cue: ease is taking effect and the fade is explained by the lower power; replaced the fade watch with a boat-efficiency watch

arguments.text: Current helps this leg. Ease, cruise at one sixty five.

arguments.message: past turn at 3000 m: against-current leg 4, a 165 ground target would be far too hard, re-cue

arguments.text: 11.4 min, 2030 m, leg 3 (with current, push fit still lagging the turn): ease faded, shaft back to 168, pod reserve 7.7%. Speed water slipping 3.0 -> 2.85, boat/shaft 0.61 -> 0.54-0.57 (fatigue of blade, or turn effect; watch eff_drop). Cued ease with ground pace 165 (about CP with +0.22 current). MUST re-cue after the 3000 m turn: against current 165 ground would be far too hard; there use ~185-188 or no pace.

text: cued ease to 165 ground pace on the with-current leg: shaft crept back to 168 with pod reserve under 8% and 6 km left; watch set to re-cue after the 3000 m turn

arguments.text: You are on the limit. Ease now, breathe, long race left.

14.4 min, 2600 m: pod reserve 0, shaft 164 (ignored the 165 ground target, ran 158). Paddler effort now 8/10 (4 at 4 min, 5 at 6 min) though words still say plenty: CP test looks right, do NOT raise CP. boat_eff normal ~0.60 (no drag). Cued ease (no pace, turn in 400 m). Goal: shaft at or just under 154 for the rest, more on against-current legs only if reserve rebuilds. Eases fade within ~2 min: re-cue as needed.

text: cued ease: reserve empty, shaft 10 W over critical power and effort now 8 of 10 with 5.4 km left

arguments.message: shaft power dropped below 148: blowing up or easing
paddler surging above 172 W shaft with far to go
last 1150 m: plan the finish (last leg is against current)

arguments.text: 16.7 min, 3030 m (leg 4, against current): last ease ignored, shaft steady 162-164 for ~8 min, pod reserve 0 for ~3 min, fade stable -3.5 to -4.4, effort 7/10 (was 8). Paddler seems to sit at a self-chosen ~163 W and is not collapsing: true CP or reserve may be a bit above the test. Stopped cueing ease; not changing CP yet. Watches: blowup (shaft<148), surge (shaft>172), finish_plan (remaining<1150). Last leg 7-8 km is against current: finish push there, length set by how they look then.

text: no cue: paddler is holding a steady 163 W with stable fade and effort 7 of 10; further ease cues are being ignored, so watching for a blow-up or surge instead

arguments.text: Hold this effort. Your push comes at the last turn.

17.7 min, 3200 m: paddler asked to go harder (I feel strong). Shaft 166, pod reserve 0, fade creeping -4.0 -> -5.0, boat_eff ~0.55-0.58. Cued hold: push saved for the last turn at 7000 m (last leg against current). If they surge anyway the surge watch will wake me.

text: cued hold: paddler wants to go harder with 4.8 km left on an empty reserve; push saved for the last leg

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish at 9000 m

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish is at nine k now.

20.4 min, 3610 m: RADIO said course extended, finish now 9000 m. Set race distance 9000 and told paddler (distance_left 5390). Last leg (8-9 km) is now WITH current (north). History: shaft steady 160-166 since 10.8 min with pod reserve 0 since 14 min and no collapse -> true CP/reserve likely somewhat above test (CP not changed). Boat efficiency is lower on against-current legs (0.55-0.58) than with-current (0.59-0.61): a direction pattern (wind?), not growing drag. Finish push: start around 8000-8300 m, length by how they look then.

text: course extended to 9000 m: set the race distance and told the paddler the finish is 5.4 km away

arguments.text: 23.4 min, 4090 m (leg 5, with current): speed water 2.76 / boat_eff 0.49 just after the 4000 m turn were the turn transient (GPS 30-s mean still climbing 2.6 -> 3.0, drag_gap back to -0.05). Shaft still 166, pod reserve 0, no collapse. No cue. Leg 3 reference with current: GPS 3.11-3.16, water 2.90-2.94 at shaft 164.

text: no cue: the low boat speed was the turn transient; paddler steady at 166 W shaft

arguments.text: Clear the rudder: one back-stroke, then settle into rhythm.

24.3 min, 4260 m (leg 5, with current): shaft fell 166 -> 138 at ~23.5 min (blow-up watch; effort 8/10). Speed also lost more than the power drop explains: boat_eff 0.60 -> 0.50, push_local 0.11 vs push_along 0.22, GPS 2.83-2.90 vs 3.11-3.16 on leg 3. Could be weed on the rudder or a tired blade. Cued clear_rudder at 24.4 min as a cheap test. CHECK next wake-up: if boat_eff back near 0.58-0.60 and drag_gap near 0 -> it was weed; if not -> tired blade/blow-up, let them recover below CP (154) and keep CP as tested.

arguments.message: check whether clearing the rudder at 24.4 min restored boat_eff and drag_gap

text: cued clear_rudder: power dropped and the boat lost more speed than that explains, a cheap test for weed; check-back watch set at 26 min
no cue: efficiency alert is the drop already acted on with the clear-rudder cue 15 s ago; check-back at 26 min

arguments.text: 24.9 min: paddler says boat feels heavy all of a sudden, something on the rudder? Supports weed. 25 s after my clear_rudder cue no recovery yet (shaft 137, water 2.65, push_local 0.14 vs push_along 0.20). At the 26 min check: if boat_eff still ~0.5, cue clear_rudder again.

text: no cue: cue gate closed for 35 s and the clear-rudder cue was just given; will repeat it at the 26 min check if the boat is still slow
